name: Clay
positioning: GTM infrastructure for growth: data marketplace + Audiences data layer, Claygents/Account Agents, Workflows orchestration, and execution (sequencer/ads). Positions as AI growth engine / self-learning revenue engine for GTM engineers — not classic AI SDR or AI CRM.

recent.title: OpenAI customer story: Clay on GPT-6, plugins in ChatGPT and Codex
recent.summary: Nov 24 OpenAI story: Clay uses GPT-6 Sol as primary model, GPT-6 Astra for harder tasks, GPT-6 Luna for cost-sensitive work (Claygent research/qualification/enrichment/signals + workflow-building agent) via the Responses API; Clay plugins in Codex (build/run GTM plays) and ChatGPT (account/deal research). Jeff Barg (Head of AI): working on inbound sales-development features where an agent shows a product to a prospect; eyeing GPT-Live-1 voice and the Decisions API.

recent.title: Make It Great Week: 67 shipped fixes incl. credit changes
recent.summary: Nov 24 LinkedIn: zero credits when a Crunchbase funding lookup returns empty; label showing which third-party enrichments cost zero credits; Google Maps multi-location search; better senior-title matching; Forager jobs/people by domain; G2 vendor products, prices paid, contract lengths and switching reasons; Upriver creators; Slack thread replies for deal updates; large HubSpot deal imports; full Salesforce field mapping; Apify scheduled imports; HTTP QUERY requests; phone-lookup stop on repeat results; Trestle Real Contact 2.0.

recent.title: Lead-scoring how-to: fit + engagement scores in a Clay Workflow
recent.summary: Nov 23 blog (Outbound Plays): separate account-fit (third-party firmographics) and lead-engagement (first-party activity) scores, route into work-now / nurture / buying-committee / skip; new signals trigger rescoring; global agent (beta) can build the workflow. Content, not a launch.

recent.title: Amazon Bedrock connection: run Clay AI actions on the customer's own AWS account
recent.summary: Nov 20 blog (Clay Announcements): supported Clay AI and agent actions can run on Amazon Bedrock in the customer's AWS account, under the customer's AWS agreement. Access via OpenID Connect workload identity federation and an IAM role whose trust policy is bound to one Clay workspace and connection; short-lived credentials, no long-lived AWS key; removing the role ends access. Clay stays SaaS. Setup through the Clay Growth Strategist and AWS admin; economics depend on AWS terms.

recent.title: GTA6 giveaway for plan upgrades before the weekend (global agent launch promo)
recent.summary: Nov 19 X post (co-founder Varun Anand): to celebrate the global agent launch, Clay gives GTA6 to every user who upgrades their Clay plan before the weekend; describes the global agent as long-running and outcomes-based.

recent.title: Global agent in open beta: describe a GTM play, Clay plans, builds and tests it
recent.summary: Nov 19: in-product agent (Agent tab) that plans and builds plays across Search, Audiences, Workflows and Sequencer; reads and writes Knowledge Hub (ICP, personas, products, competitors) and reads Audiences activity (CRM, warehouse, Gong calls, emails); tests on a sample of real records and shows estimated cost on an approval card before scaling; reusable skills plus a marketplace; per-user spend under Settings → Usage → Agent. Uses data credits with a one-time beta credit grant; open beta on paid Enterprise, Growth and Launch plans. Clay says GTM engineers already built this way via the Clay CLI.

recent.title: Relaunched official ChatGPT MCP: build audiences, workflows and campaigns in chat
recent.summary: Nov 17: new Clay MCP in ChatGPT reaches parity with the Clay CLI; users can build prospect audiences, enrichment workflows (Claygent, 200+ providers), Sequencer campaigns and ad audiences with in-chat previews. Building needs Editor/Admin; works on all plans incl. free; same credits as the app; replaces Clay for Reps MCP; other chat platforms 'soon'. Launched alongside OpenAI's ChatGPT for Sales, where Clay is a prospecting partner. Coverage: https://www.unite.ai/clay-adds-sales-workflow-building-and-previews-to-chatgpt-plugin/

recent.title: Guide: Clay as built-in connector in Anthropic's Claude for Small Business
recent.summary: Nov 13 blog: Clay is one of 37 connectors in the Claude for Small Business plugin (43 workflows); guide covers finding/enriching prospects via Clay MCP in Claude chat and turning it into a weekly workflow with the Clay CLI and ICP Sequencer Workflow skill in Claude Code. Livestream with Anthropic's Jaskirat Gaelan. How-to/distribution, not a product launch.

recent.title: Updated GTM engineer hiring guide with comp benchmarks
recent.summary: Nov 10 X post: Clay says it coined the GTM engineer title in 2023 and published an updated hiring guide with interview questions, take-home ideas, and compensation benchmarks.

recent.title: Blog: 'The ceiling on your GTM agent is the data, not the model' (Account Agent vs generic MCP)
recent.summary: Nov 3 (Linda Ye, Nisola Shobayo): five synthetic enterprise accounts with planted risks; Clay Account Agents on Audiences vs a general-purpose agent with Salesforce+Gong tools. Clay averaged 39K vs 250K input tokens, 23s vs 60s answers, caught duplicate-account procurement threat 30/30 vs 18/30, and conflicting risk fields 16/30 vs 0/30. Filesystem-style account browse scored 0.92 vs 0.82 typed tools on account-history questions. Thought leadership / product proof, not a new GA.

recent.title: Claygent auto-mode becomes the default model setting (router post-trained with Applied Compute)
recent.summary: Oct 27 blog: auto-mode routes each Claygent task to a model by predicted quality vs cost, with a per-category quality floor; router AC-001 is a post-trained open-weight model served on Applied Compute's AC2, deciding in under a second at hundreds of millions of queries a month. Clay reports 47% lower cost on production traffic than always using the most capable model. No extra charge; default for new Claygent columns, workflow nodes and Claygent Builder; existing Claygents keep their model.

recent.title: X: collaborating with SpaceXAI to put Grok Bot to work in Clay (build session Oct 29)
recent.summary: @clay says it is collaborating with SpaceXAI: Grok Bot builds Clay workflows from natural language, researches companies, enriches contacts, drafts emails for rep review, and can fill web forms, log into apps and pull Clay data from a phone. Live session Oct 29, 2:30–3:30pm ET with Alex Lindahl (Clay) and Matt Silberman (SpaceXSI). Announcement only; no integration docs. Also Oct 22: blog announcing 2026 Data Partner Awards (recognition, not product).

recent.title: Blog: 'In an Agentic GTM Era, Sales Plays Will Ship Like Software' (GTM CI/CD)
recent.summary: Clay describes internal GTM CI/CD: agent proposes change → human approves → Clay CLI deploys; every workflow run logged per step with snapshots before edits. Examples: SDR message generator with A/B prompt branches (drafting ~7 min → 1 min, company figure), 'self-healing workflows' (nightly review found 47 of 159 leads mis-segmented), Terra rep tool. Says Clay CLI/API calls hit 1M/day within two months of release. Plans to bring self-learning loops (next-best message/play/strategy) into the product; no date.
